text_simplified: Whenever trials intensify, parents must redouble their efforts to protect their children and keep them away from forbidden matters, while taking care to choose righteous friends and companions for their daughter, for a companion draws one along. The Prophet ﷺ highlighted the effect of companionship and environment even in tending animals when he said: "Pride and arrogance are among the loud-voiced owners of camels, and tranquility is among the owners of sheep" (Sahih al-Bukhari 3499). A righteous, devout friend assists parents in raising their daughter well, whereas a corrupt friend is like the blacksmith's bellows.

source_meta.source_title: Lamahat fi Tarbiyat al-Banat (Glimpses into Raising Daughters)

review_defects.why: The Arabic uses the singular «الصديقة الصالحة» (the righteous female friend), while the English renders it as plural "Righteous Friends".
"and environment" is added in English; the Arabic mentions only «أثر المخالطة» (the effect of companionship/mixing).
"loud-voiced" is an interpretive gloss added to the hadith wording that is not in the Arabic text.
The hadith as recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari 3499 includes «والوقار» after «والسكينة»; the Arabic source slightly shortens the hadith.
